portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Carnival Legend makes her Seattle debut in 2027 with a full season of week-long Alaska voyages.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A Fun Day at Sea heading north — Waterworks, Guy's Burger Joint, and Sea Day Brunch while the coastline rolls past.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising deep into a narrow, 30-mile fjord walled by granite cliffs and waterfalls, ending at the twin Sawyer Glaciers. Watch for harbor seals on the ice floes.
portsOfCall.name: Tracy Arm Fjord

portsOfCall.description: A full day (7 AM–8 PM) in the Gold Rush gateway. Ride the White Pass & Yukon Route Railway, hike to Lower Dewey Lake, or stroll the boardwalks of Broadway.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital, reachable only by sea or air. Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching in Auke Bay, and the Mount Roberts Tramway are all close to the pier.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A morning in the 'Salmon Capital of the World' — Creek Street, Totem Bight State Park, or a floatplane over Misty Fjords.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An evening call in British Columbia's garden city — stroll the Inner Harbour, see the Parliament Buildings lit up, or visit Butchart Gardens.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

cabinCategories.description: Carnival Legend interior stateroom — one of the lowest-priced ways to see Alaska from Seattle in 2027. Two twins convertible to a king.
Ocean view stateroom with picture window for glimpses of Tracy Arm's waterfalls and the Inside Passage.
Private balcony stateroom — fresh Alaska air and a front-row seat for Tracy Arm Fjord scenic cruising.
Ocean Suite with separate sitting area, oversized balcony, whirlpool tub, and priority embarkation.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Lido Marketplace
Guy's Burger Joint and BlueIguana Cantina
entertainmentOptions: Live music in the Alchemy Bar and RedFrog Rum Bar
reviewSnippet: Carnival's new Seattle ship for 2027 brings a long day in Skagway and scenic cruising in Tracy Arm Fjord at Carnival's value price point — a strong pick for families and first-time cruisers.

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal) for a 16-night round-trip to Hawaii — no flights needed.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Five Fun Days at Sea crossing the Pacific to Hawaii — Waterworks, Serenity, and Sea Day Brunch.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Crossing

portsOfCall.description: A long day (9 AM–10 PM) in Honolulu: Waikiki Beach, Pearl Harbor, and Diamond Head.
portsOfCall.name: Honolulu, Oahu, HI

portsOfCall.description: The Garden Isle — Waimea Canyon, the Nā Pali Coast, and Wailua River.
portsOfCall.name: Nawiliwili, Kauai, HI

portsOfCall.description: Road to Hāna, Haleakalā crater, and Maui's beaches (9 AM–9:30 PM).
portsOfCall.name: Kahului, Maui, HI

portsOfCall.description: Gateway to Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park and Rainbow Falls.
portsOfCall.name: Hilo, Hawaii Island, HI

portsOfCall.description: Five sea days sailing back to the Pacific Northwest.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Crossing

portsOfCall.description: A full-day call in British Columbia's garden city (9 AM–6 PM) — Butchart Gardens and the Inner Harbour.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

cabinCategories.description: Interior stateroom for the 16-night Hawaii voyage.
Ocean view stateroom — watch the open Pacific on ten sea days.
Private balcony stateroom — ideal for warm-weather sea days.

overrides.note: Arrival only — the Hawaii cruise returns this day; no bookable Seattle departure found.
